$comment: General arrangement: the single source of truth for where things are on the ship. Read by src/vessel/vessel-layout.ts (app) and scripts/blender/hull_lib.py (hull GLB). Coordinates are three.js scene units: x stern->bow, y up, z port(-)/starboard(+). Equipment position = centre in plan, bottom in height; size = max assembled extent before equipmentScale.
